implementation_note: Completes the units owner's SDK-eligible scope by exporting the existing typed option/parameter contract (OptionDomain/CommandSchema) rather than adding a second validator.
app_features: om9-app --no-default-features (standalone Controller/document/scene/archive; no OCCT adapter, no FreeCAD/Rhino host)
asserted_semantics: The typed wire form tags the unit: length/millimeters, angle/degrees, ratio, count, choice, boolean, text. A bare JSON number is refused (parameter) and an angle record cannot deserialize as a length.
Bounds are canonical (mm/degrees); minimum is exclusive unless min_inclusive; max is inclusive; step is measured from min (or zero).
A count must be a non-negative integer; wrong dimension, missing unit, value outside a choice list or text over max_bytes is a parameter refusal.
apply_parameters fills declared defaults, refuses unknown names and missing required parameters, refuses a default that violates its own domain, and returns the typed canonical map.
Validation stages no document mutation: the document and Undo/Redo are unchanged.
The exported rule is the one command admission uses (OptionDomain/CommandSchema), not a parallel copy; the app does not yet have a builder parameter editor.
